sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:234

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:234:1
items.html: In “Shema Yisrael” there is a second Ibur of Katnut of Tevuna: Namely, the continuation of the second Ibur, that comes after the two years of nursing, which began at the Shema of the sacrifices, where it received the surrounding lights of the Katnut of Ima, and the internal lights of the Katnut of Aba. And now, at the word “Yisrael,” this second Ibur is concluded, and it receives the surrounding lights of the Katnut of Aba, which is the completion of the Mochin of the first second Ibur. As above (page 1180, the passage beginning “And all”). Study it there well, all the continuation.
